name: India-Pakistan International Maritime Boundary Line (IMBL)
description: International Maritime Boundary Line between India and Pakistan in the Arabian Sea / Sir Creek sector. Crossing triggers immediate apprehension risk by foreign coast guard.

name: India-Sri Lanka International Maritime Boundary Line (IMBL)
description: Maritime Boundary Line between India and Sri Lanka in Palk Strait and Gulf of Mannar. Strict naval monitoring zone.

name: Gulf of Mannar Marine National Park
description: Protected Marine Sanctuary and Biosphere Reserve in Tamil Nadu. Commercial mechanized trawling and purse-seining are strictly prohibited by law.

name: Malvan Marine Sanctuary (Sindhudurg)
description: Coastal Marine Protected Area in southern Maharashtra protecting coral reefs and marine flora. Commercial fishing strictly regulated.

name: Gahirmatha Marine Sanctuary (Odisha)
description: Mass nesting sanctuary for endangered Olive Ridley Sea Turtles. Seasonal fishing prohibition zone enforced by Indian Coast Guard.
